title: Stay Ready for El Niño!
description:
El Niño may bring significant weather impacts to our communities this fall and winter, including the possibility of heavy rainfall. Here's how you can protect yourself and your loved ones: 

✓ Have a portable emergency go kit. Make sure valuables, documents and medications are readily available and in waterproof containers.

✓ Have an evacuation plan. Identify a location to meet up with loved ones and ways to communicate. 

✓ Sign up for emergency alerts.

✓ Make sure your car is in good condition, check windshield wipers and tires.

✓ Have flashlights handy.

Learn more: sandiego.gov/elnino

#StayReadySanDiego #ElNiño #NationalPreparednessMonth
